verdict.rationale: Letta documents agent-driven memory writes. With /remember, the agent itself decides where a lesson belongs and commits the update to its file-based MemFS memory repository, and dreaming subagents consolidate and update memory. Search needs an installable MemFS Search mod, and deletion is never documented. Missing for 10: documented agent-invoked delete operation, a native memory-search tool (not an add-on mod), explicit documentation of the agent's autonomous memory tool calls without a user command, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can manage its own memory mid-conversation — adding, searching, updating, and deleting memories through tools or API calls it invokes itself

citations.quote: The agent decides where the lesson belongs and commits the update to MemFS.
Dreaming uses background subagents to review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting your active work.
Each entry becomes a Markdown file in the agent’s memory repository
For keyword search and optional semantic or hybrid search, install the [MemFS Search mod]
